I am trying to add Generalized Hyperbolic distribution to Stan. For that I need Modified Bessel function of the second kind with real nu parameter, but this is not available in Stan. While searching through the group archives, I found some code by Ben Goodrich, but when I try to use it, somehow the whole sampling stops, and print() shows nothing.
So, I was thinking that I would like to debug at C++ level the generated code, but I am not sure how to start.
Any help would be appreciated.

Regards,
Slawek
